ASTERWILD: LANTERN ISLES

An original creature-catching RPG opening created for this project.

Original illustrated environments, characters and creatures were generated for
Asterwild, then composed, scaled and converted into native DS assets. The world
geometry, sprite layering, interface, gameplay and original PCM music were
created for this game. No graphics or ROM content from commercial games are
included. Checked-in artwork allows rebuilding without an image service.

Text and title lettering use DejaVu Sans/Serif. Font license: licenses/DejaVu.txt.
Native platform: libnds, devkitARM startup/linker files, newlib and GCC runtime.
libnds license: licenses/libnds.txt. Pinned upstream sources and platform details
are documented in platform/README.md and tools/setup_nds.sh. Startup sources:
https://github.com/devkitPro/devkitarm-crtls/tree/1c0c10257c44bbb5a433453bb6bba91582825492

Delta is the intended iPhone frontend. The game was tested in native Nintendo
DS emulation with DeSmuME. Delta itself and a physical DS were not tested here.
